sloka: निष्कूजमाना शकुनि झिल्लिका गण नादितम् ।लक्ष्मण अनुचरोओ रामो वन मध्यम् ददर्श ह ॥३-२-३॥
transliteration: niṣkūjamānā śakuni jhillikā gaṇa nāditam ।lakṣmaṇa anucaroo rāmo vana madhyam dadarśa ha ॥3-2-3॥

translations.english: With Lakshmana following, Rama went through the forest, filled with herds of animals and inhabited by bears and tigers. It was a place where trees, creepers and bushes were crushed (by frequent visits of demons). It was difficult to locate a water source. And it resounded with the chirping of various birds and insects (crickets).
